name: Mara
text: Harbor Voices is at the weighbridge today, where every lorry of fish is weighed & logged.

name: Jonas
text:
The bridge is accurate to twenty kilos.
That sounds like a lot until you see a full lorry, which is about eighteen tonnes.
We recalibrate it every March with test weights from the city.

name: Mara
text: Has anyone ever tried to cheat it?

name: Jonas
content: Once. He parked with two wheels off the plate. The bridge cannot tell, but I can see out of the window.
